Snapshot of https://github.com/voidmain02/KgScripts (MIT), commit
12a7c12dc1ef1247b615a7e611703140223b0ff1 (2022-10-12).

Bundled into the extension at build time and used when the `userScripts` API is not
available. Update with `npm run sync-userscripts`. Do not edit these files by hand.

KG_YandexTranslator is intentionally not bundled: it contains a Yandex API key
(rejected by GitHub push protection) and is marked broken upstream.
